name: KGI Securities (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: KGI Securities (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities and derivatives business in Thailand. It provides securities brokerage, securities dealing, investment advisory, securities underwriting, securities borrowing and lending, securities registrar, derivatives brokerage, and financial advisory services, as well as over-the-counter derivatives; and sells mutual fund units. The company also offers equity and derivatives trading, derivative warrants, fixed income, exchange traded funds, structured notes, and depositary receipts.
